displayName: Shree Jagannatha Rath Yatra - The Divine Procession
author: Ashish Gupta — Digital Builders

phase1.name: The Divine Emergence
phase1.prompt: The three divine deities Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra smile gently, their jewelry shimmering with divine golden light. The camera does a subtle, slow-motion pan around them. Masterpiece, cinematic lighting, ultra-realistic, highly detailed.
phase1.negativePrompt: blur, cartoon, low quality, modern, sci-fi

phase2.name: Ascending the Chariots
phase2.prompt: The three cute divine deities, Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra, are joyfully dancing together outside the temple. They gaze up in awe at the massive, beautifully decorated Rath (chariot). A festive atmosphere surrounds them as they gracefully ascend and take their seats on the majestic wooden chariot. Masterpiece, highly detailed, vibrant colors.

phase3.name: The Grand Procession
phase3.prompt: The three deities are seated majestically on their massive decorated wooden chariot. A massive sea of devoted people eagerly drag the huge thick ropes of the Rath. The crowd is filled with a euphoric festival vibe, devotees dancing with immense love, tears of devotion, celebrating the Rath Yatra. Cinematic scale, epic atmosphere.

ambient.name: Sacred Emergence
ambient.prompt: Sacred Jagannatha Temple ambience. Deep resonant conch shell drone. Massive brass temple bells ringing. Distant thousands chanting Hari Bol rhythmically. Mardala clay drum rhythmic heartbeat. Joyous and deeply spiritual.

transformation.name: Joyous Festival
transformation.prompt: Euphoric Indian festival sounds. Loud joyous shouts of Jai Jagannath. The heavy sound of massive wooden chariot wheels turning on stone. Millions of people cheering. Rhythmic clapping and singing. Vibrant and explosive devotion.

music.name: Devotional Score
music.prompt: Traditional devotional orchestral score. Joyous fast-paced tabla and mardala rhythms. Beautiful bansuri flute melody. A large male and female choir singing soaring Sanskrit hymns in celebration. Uplifting, divine, and intensely emotional.
